subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard gain a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate, or should this review flow be redesigned around the existing `review` and `done` lifecycle?
rationale: The PR changes persisted Workboard status and completion behavior, which can intentionally stop existing Workboard flows at runtime; automation can identify defects but cannot choose the permanent lifecycle contract.

options.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
options.body: Preserve current response contracts, require review proof for all completion paths, register the new tool/status everywhere, and require upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign around existing statuses
options.body: Avoid adding `ready_to_merge` until maintainers explicitly want a new durable Workboard state, and enforce review using existing lifecycle states instead.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the PR open only as design input until a maintainer sponsors the review-gate lifecycle direction.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Preserve current response contracts, require review proof for all completion paths, register the new tool/status everywhere, and require upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest Workboard feature-history owner across the tool, type, manifest, and lifecycle surfaces involved.
